Class RcxRegulatedMotor

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.remote.lego.rcx.RcxRegulatedMotor
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseMotor, DCMotor, Encoder, RegulatedMotor
public final class RcxRegulatedMotor extends Object implements RegulatedMotor, Encoder
One side of an RcxRegulatedPair, as the RegulatedMotor contract: speed and acceleration are the pair's, a rotation of this side starts a movement in which the other side stays where it is, and the tachometer is this side's own. Get it from RcxRegulatedPair.left() or RcxRegulatedPair.right().

Only regulated movements exist on the brick, so the open-loop calls (forward(), backward(), flt(), setPower(int), getPower()) throw UnsupportedOperationException; use rotate(int).
